tag: 鄰域圈層進度 · 補收缺漏
body: 安基生技 AJ201（SBMA）正式向 FDA 送件 Ph3 樞紐試驗 IND：公告日 2026/09/03，內容為已完成三期試驗計畫並向美國 FDA 提出甘迺迪氏症（SBMA）第三期臨床試驗申請，全球規劃收案約 200 人，實際執行時程配合未來國際授權夥伴策略調整；依 IND 審查機制，若 FDA 於標準 30 天審查期間未要求補充資料，最快 2026 Q4 可啟動美國三期。公司稱 AJ201 為全球唯一已知朝三期推進的 SBMA 候選新藥。
note: → 本則為補收此前遺漏：此為台灣財經媒體 2026/09/03 公告，此前每日掃描窗期（reldate 導向的近期新聞搜尋）皆未撈到，本次主動補查後收錄。AJ201 屬鄰域 polyQ 圈層（SBMA）而非直接 SCA 競品，但其孤兒藥資格另含 SCA，是最可能從鄰近適應症切入 SCA 的在地公司，此進度可視為監管路徑的參考先例。⚠️ 僅見台灣財經媒體（工商時報／經濟日報／鉅亨網）轉載安基公告，未查得公司官網或英文一手新聞稿佐證；「全球唯一」為公司自述；與被授權方 Avenue Therapeutics 之間仍有 2025/03 起的解盲時程仲裁爭議未見後續公開進展，本站不臆測其現況。

en.body: AnnJi Biotech has formally filed an IND with the FDA for a Phase 3 pivotal trial of AJ201 in SBMA: per a disclosure dated 2026/09/03, the company completed its Phase 3 protocol and submitted a Phase 3 clinical trial application for Kennedy's disease (SBMA) to the FDA, planning to enrol around 200 patients globally, with actual execution to be adjusted alongside future international licensing strategy; under standard IND review, if the FDA requests no additional information within its 30-day window, the US Phase 3 could start as early as Q4 2026. The company states AJ201 is the only SBMA candidate globally known to be advancing toward Phase 3.
en.note: → This entry back-fills a previously missed item: the disclosure is dated 2026/09/03 and was not caught by prior daily scans (recency-windowed news searches); it was surfaced and recorded on a deliberate re-check. AJ201 sits in the adjacent polyQ ring (SBMA) rather than being a direct SCA competitor, but its orphan designation also covers SCA, making it the local company most likely to enter SCA from an adjacent indication, so this milestone serves as a regulatory-pathway reference point. ⚠️ Reported only by Taiwanese financial media (Commercial Times / Economic Daily News / Anue) relaying AnnJi's own disclosure; no corroborating company website statement or English-language press release was found; "globally only" is the company's own characterisation; the 2025/03 arbitration dispute with licensee Avenue Therapeutics over the unblinding schedule has no reported public resolution, and this site does not speculate on its current status.

tag: SCA3 試驗讀出 · 追蹤名單外新路線
body: SCA3 出現一個主要指標達標的口服小分子隨機對照試驗：中南大學湘雅醫院團隊於 Movement Disorders（2026/09/15 線上）發表 DL-3-n-丁苯酞（NBP）治療 SCA3 的 12 個月隨機安慰劑對照試驗。mITT 116 人，SARA 12 個月變化組間差 −0.86（95% CI −1.56 至 −0.16；P=0.02）、SCAFI 差 0.16（P=0.03），雙主要指標皆有利於 NBP；兩組無嚴重不良事件，藥物相關不良事件 NBP 組數字上較多（21.4% vs 10.0%，P=0.09）。
note: → 與本社同一核心適應症（SCA3）、同一主要量表（SARA）。⚠️ 效果量小（一年差不到 1 SARA 分）、單一國家研究者發起、分析族群為 mITT；摘要未載盲法、站點數與試驗登錄號，ClinicalTrials.gov 以藥名查無登錄，本站不代為補寫。作者自稱為「初步」證據，距任何監管申請仍遠。

en.tag: SCA3 trial readout · new route outside the tracked list
en.body: A randomised controlled trial of an oral small molecule has met its primary endpoints in SCA3: a Xiangya Hospital (Central South University) group published in Movement Disorders (online 2026/09/15) a 12-month randomised placebo-controlled trial of DL-3-n-butylphthalide (NBP) in SCA3. In an mITT population of 116, the between-group difference in 12-month SARA change was −0.86 (95% CI −1.56 to −0.16; P=0.02) and in SCAFI 0.16 (P=0.03), both primary endpoints favouring NBP; there were no serious adverse events in either group, and drug-related adverse events were numerically more frequent on NBP (21.4% vs 10.0%, P=0.09).
en.note: → Same core indication (SCA3) and same primary scale (SARA) as Steminent. ⚠️ The effect size is small (under one SARA point over a year), and the study is single-country, investigator-initiated and analysed in an mITT population; the abstract does not state the blinding, number of sites or registration number, a drug-name search of ClinicalTrials.gov finds no registration, and nothing is filled in here. The authors call the evidence 'preliminary', and any regulatory filing remains distant.

tag: 競品公司動態 · 非 SCA 資產
body: Biohaven 另一條主力管線遭 FDA 部分臨床暫停：公司 2026/09/09 向美國 SEC 提交 8-K 揭露，FDA 於 2026/09/04 發函，對 Kv7 鉀離子通道促效劑 BHV-7000（opakalim）的局部癲癇試驗 BHV7000-302、-303 及開放標籤延伸 -201 施以部分臨床暫停，範圍僅限「新病人收案」；已隨機分派的逾 600 名受試者繼續給藥。原因是囓齒類試驗觀察到的某一代謝物資訊不足、尚無法評估對人體的風險，FDA 要求補充非臨床資料。公司稱 BHV7000-303 已完成收案、topline 仍維持 2026 下半年。BioSpace 報導公司股價於 09/10 盤前下跌逾 13%。
note: → 本則與 troriluzole／SCA 無直接關係——8-K 全文未提及 troriluzole 或 SCA，本站不推論此事對 troriluzole 在 2025/11/04 CRL 之後的重新送件時程或資源配置有何影響。收錄理由是 Biohaven 為本站主要追蹤競品，公司層級的研發挫折屬背景訊號（BioSpace 同篇報導回顧：troriluzole 遭拒後公司研發預算削減 60%、BHV-7000 憂鬱症二期 2025/12 失敗）。⚠️ 「股價跌逾 13%」「研發預算削減 60%」為媒體報導數字，非 8-K 原文；BHV-7000 於 2026/08 下旬與 SK Biopharmaceuticals 簽授權，各報導金額口徑不一，本站不引用。

en.body: Another lead Biohaven programme has been placed on partial clinical hold by the FDA: in an 8-K filed with the US SEC on 2026/09/09, the company disclosed that the FDA issued a letter on 2026/09/04 placing its focal epilepsy trials of the Kv7 potassium channel opener BHV-7000 (opakalim) — BHV7000-302 and -303 and the open-label extension -201 — on a partial clinical hold limited to new patient enrolment; more than 600 patients already randomised continue dosing. The reason is that information on a specific metabolite observed in rodent studies is insufficient to assess its risk to humans, and additional nonclinical data were requested. The company says BHV7000-303 is fully enrolled and topline data remain on track for the second half of 2026. BioSpace reported the shares fell more than 13% in premarket trading on 09/10.
en.note: → This has no direct bearing on troriluzole or SCA — the 8-K does not mention troriluzole or SCA, and this site draws no inference about any effect on the timing or resourcing of a troriluzole resubmission after the CRL of 2025/11/04. It is recorded because Biohaven is a principal tracked competitor and company-level R&D setbacks are background signal (the same BioSpace report recalls a 60% R&D budget cut after the troriluzole rejection and the failure of BHV-7000's Phase 2 in depression in 2025/12). ⚠️ The 13% share fall and 60% budget cut are media-reported figures, not from the 8-K; BHV-7000 was licensed to SK Biopharmaceuticals in late August 2026, and because reported deal values differ between outlets, none is cited here.

tag: 監管里程碑 · 已核准
body: 共濟失調圈層出現第一個以 SARA 為註冊主要指標獲 FDA 核准的案子：IntraBio 的 levacetylleucine（AQNEURSA®）於 2026/09/19（PDUFA 行動日當天）獲 FDA 核准，用於治療毛細血管擴張性共濟失調（A-T，體重≥15公斤之成人與兒童）的共濟失調症狀——為全球第一個 A-T 核准療法。核准依據為樞紐三期 IB1001-303（NCT06673056），公司與 FDA 均稱其主要指標與全部關鍵次要指標達統計顯著。同成分已以 Aqneursa 於 Niemann-Pick C 上市。
note: → 對本社有兩層意義，方向相反。（一）有利：這是共濟失調領域第一個以 SARA 為註冊主要指標走完 FDA 審查並獲准的案子，等於替「SARA 可作為註冊終點」建立監管先例，對本社以 SARA 為主要指標的開發路徑是外部背書。（二）警訊：同一分子的 IB1001-304 明列 SCA6、與本社日本申請適應症正面重疊；此次 A-T 率先核准後，該分子在共濟失調醫師社群的熟悉度、安全性資料庫與給付路徑都已領先本社一步。⚠️ FDA 與公司公告均未附具體數值、p 值或效果量（IB1001-303 於 2026/05 首度揭露時亦同）。

en.body: The ataxia ring now has its first FDA approval of a filing whose registrational primary endpoint was SARA: IntraBio's levacetylleucine (AQNEURSA®) was approved by the FDA on 2026/09/19 (its PDUFA action date) to treat ataxia symptoms in ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T, adults and children ≥15 kg) — the first approved therapy for A-T anywhere. The approval rests on the pivotal Phase 3 IB1001-303 (NCT06673056), which the company and the FDA both describe as meeting its primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints with statistical significance. The same molecule is already marketed as Aqneursa in Niemann-Pick disease type C.
en.note: → Two implications for us, pointing in opposite directions. (1) In our favour: this is the first filing in the ataxia field to complete FDA review and be approved with SARA as its registrational primary endpoint, establishing the precedent that SARA can serve as a registrational endpoint — external validation of our own SARA-based development path. (2) A warning: the same molecule's IB1001-304 explicitly lists SCA6, overlapping the indication in our Japan filing directly, and having secured the A-T approval first, it now leads us in physician familiarity, safety database and reimbursement pathway across the ataxia community. ⚠️ Neither the FDA announcement nor the company has released specific figures, p-values or effect sizes (also true of IB1001-303's initial disclosure in 2026/05).

body: Larimar 的 nomlabofusp 全球確認性三期已開始收案（NCT07778836）。登錄於 2026/08/21 首次上線，實際起始日 2026/08/05，狀態為收案中；隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、多中心，預計收案 150 人，納入成人與兒童之基因確診（GAA 同型合子）Friedreich's ataxia、mFARS 總分 ≥20 且 <60。雙主要終點皆在第 72 週：mFARS 的 Upright Stability Score（subscale E）與 mFARS 總分之基線變化，主要完成日預估 2029/07。目前僅登錄 3 站、全在美國（Northwestern、Clinilabs、UT Southwestern）。
note: → 這是鄰近共濟失調圈層（Friedreich's）而非 SCA 的直接競品，但結構上值得記一筆：該藥的加速核准滾動式 BLA（2026/06 送出第一模組）走的是 frataxin 濃度替代終點，本三期則是臨床療效的確認性試驗，兩者並行。⚠️ 本試驗尚無任何療效數據；公司先前公開的商業化目標時點（2027 年年中上市）屬公司自述，非監管承諾。

links.label: 滾動式 BLA 首模組 ↗ 2026/06

en.body: Larimar's global confirmatory Phase 3 of nomlabofusp has begun enrolling (NCT07778836). The registration was first posted on 2026/08/21 with an actual start date of 2026/08/05 and a status of recruiting; it is randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled and multicentre, targeting 150 subjects, enrolling adults and children with genetically confirmed (homozygous GAA) Friedreich's ataxia and a total mFARS score ≥20 and <60. Both primary endpoints fall at Week 72: change from baseline in the mFARS Upright Stability Score (subscale E) and in total mFARS, with estimated primary completion in July 2029. Only 3 sites, all in the United States, are registered so far (Northwestern, Clinilabs and UT Southwestern).
en.note: → This sits in the adjacent ataxia ring (Friedreich's) rather than being a direct SCA competitor, but the structure is worth recording: the drug's rolling BLA for accelerated approval (first module submitted 2026/06) rests on a frataxin-concentration surrogate endpoint, while this Phase 3 is the confirmatory trial of clinical benefit, the two running in parallel. ⚠️ No efficacy data from this trial exist yet, and the commercial timing the company has stated publicly (a mid-2027 launch) is its own guidance, not a regulatory commitment.

body: IntraBio 的 CACNA1A 樞紐三期（IB1001-304／NCT07221292）已開始收案，且進度快於原訂計畫。ClinicalTrials.gov 於 2026/08/20 更新登錄，狀態自「尚未收案」轉為收案中，實際起始日為 2026/08/17——比先前登錄的估計起始日 2026/09 提前；10 個站點中已有 7 站收案中（美國 UT Health 休士頓 1 站，歐洲 6 站：Innsbruck、Cologne、Milan、羅馬 Bambino Gesù、Bern、Oxford），Johns Hopkins、麻省總醫院與雅典 3 站尚未啟動。公司在 2026/08/19 的新聞稿中表示，預期本試驗將超額收案並於 2026 年 10 月完成收案。試驗設計為 12 週隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照交叉，n≈60、4 歲以上，主要指標為 SARA，納入條件為基因確診的 CACNA1A 相關疾病，登錄的合格標準明列 SCA6（另含 EA2、FHM1）。
note: → 與本社在日本申請的 SCA6 適應症正面重疊，且此為全球第一個專為 CACNA1A 相關疾病進行的樞紐試驗，該領域目前無任何已核准療法。同成分（levacetylleucine）已以 Aqneursa 於尼曼匹克症 C 型上市，代表其安全性資料庫與供應鏈皆屬既有。⚠️ 完成時程兩來源不一致，本站並列不擇一：CT.gov 登錄的主要完成日為 2028/08/01，而公司新聞稿描述的是收案結束後 6 個月完成（推得約 2027/04）。⚠️ 目前尚無任何療效數據讀出，「超額收案」為公司自述、非第三方查核。

en.body: IntraBio's pivotal Phase III in CACNA1A-related disorders (IB1001-304 / NCT07221292) has begun enrolling, and is running ahead of its earlier plan. ClinicalTrials.gov updated the registration on 2026/08/20, moving the status from not-yet-recruiting to recruiting, with an actual start date of 2026/08/17 — earlier than the previously registered estimate of 2026/09. Seven of the 10 sites are recruiting (one in the US, UT Health Houston, and six in Europe: Innsbruck, Cologne, Milan, Bambino Gesù in Rome, Bern and Oxford), while Johns Hopkins, Massachusetts General Hospital and Athens have not yet opened. In a press release dated 2026/08/19 the company stated it expects the study to over-enrol and complete recruitment in October 2026. The design is a 12-week randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial, n≈60, age 4 and over, with SARA as the primary endpoint; eligibility requires a genetically confirmed CACNA1A-related disorder and the registered criteria explicitly list SCA6 alongside EA2 and FHM1.
en.note: → This directly overlaps the SCA6 indication in our own Japan filing, and it is the first pivotal trial conducted specifically for CACNA1A-related disorders, an area with no approved therapy anywhere. The same molecule (levacetylleucine) is already marketed as Aqneursa for Niemann-Pick disease type C, so its safety database and supply chain are established. ⚠️ The two sources disagree on the completion timeline and this site reports both rather than choosing: the registered primary completion date is 2028/08/01, whereas the press release describes completion six months after enrolment closes (implying roughly 2027/04). ⚠️ No efficacy data have been read out, and 'over-enrolment' is a company statement rather than an independently verified fact.

body: 本社 Stemchymal：6/24 產品「承認申請」(SCA3/6) 送 PMDA；6/18 MAH「業許可」送神奈川縣。

en.body: Our Stemchymal: marketing approval application (SCA3/6) filed with PMDA on 6/24; MAH business licence filed with Kanagawa Prefecture on 6/18.
